update.if: update ${table} set sendMark = 1,lastmodifierid = #{operId} where seqno = #{seqno} and sendmark is null
update ${table} set sendMark = sendMark + 1,lastmodifierid = #{operId} where seqno = #{seqno} and sendmark = #{sendmark}

mapper.select: select count(1) from FX_QUOTE_SEND_INFO i where i.PSEQNO = #{value} and i.SENDSTATUS = '1'
select count(1) from FX_QUOTE_SEND_INFO i where i.PSEQNO = #{value} and i.CREATEDTIME +5/(24*60) > sysdate
mapper.update: update ${table} set sendstatus = #{sendstatus} where seqno = #{seqno} and sendstatus != '1'
